title: ARSIA Action Discovery Response
description: Paginated response from the action discovery endpoint (GET /.well-known/arsia/actions). Contains an array of ActionDescriptor objects with pagination metadata. Defined in ARSIA-Actions.md §2.3. The endpoint MUST support 7 query parameters for filtering and pagination: category, human_oversight_required, risk_level_min (integer 0–10), risk_level_max (integer 0–10), audit_required (boolean), limit (integer, default 20, max 100), offset (integer, default 0). Multiple query parameters are combined with logical AND.

ActionDescriptor.description: Describes a single action available at an ARSIA-conformant agent. Defined in ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1.

allOf.description: Reverse domain notation with optional action path. Uniquely identifies the action within the agent's registry. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1.

category.description: High-level classification of the action's domain. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1.

description.description: Concise human-readable description of what this action does. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1.

risk_level.description: Risk assessment score (0–10) determining compliance requirements. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1–§2.2.

reversible.description: Whether this action supports rollback (ARSIA-Actions.md §4.2). Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1.

idempotent.description: Whether executing this action multiple times with identical input produces the same result. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1.

required_capabilities.description: Capabilities that a requesting agent MUST have in its access token scope to invoke this action. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1.

optional_capabilities.description: Capabilities that enhance the action's behavior when present but are not required. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1.

human_oversight_required.description: When true, the action MUST go through the pending_approval flow before execution. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1.

audit_required.description: When true, every execution MUST generate an audit record (ARSIA-State.md §7). Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1.

retention_days.description: Override retention period for audit records from this action. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1.

explainability_required.description: When true, every response MUST include a payload.explanation object (ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2). Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1.

max_execution_ms.description: Maximum execution time in milliseconds. Default 30000. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1.

required_approvals.description: Number of distinct approval_decision messages required before the action may proceed. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §3.6.

actions.description: Array of ActionDescriptor objects matching the query filters, limited by pagination parameters. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.3.

total.description: Total number of actions matching the query filters before pagination is applied. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.3.

limit.description: Maximum number of actions returned in this response. Default: 20. Maximum: 100. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.3.

offset.description: Number of actions skipped for pagination. Default: 0. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.3.
